KLEEMOD-APPLIES_PYRO.title: Applies Pyro
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_PYRO.description: Applies [gold]Pyro[/gold] for [blue]2[/blue] turns. Another aura is consumed in an [gold]Elemental Reaction[/gold].
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_HYDRO.title: Applies Hydro
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_HYDRO.description: Applies [gold]Hydro[/gold] for [blue]2[/blue] turns. Another aura is consumed in an [gold]Elemental Reaction[/gold].
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_ELECTRO.title: Applies Electro
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_ELECTRO.description: Applies [gold]Electro[/gold] for [blue]2[/blue] turns. Another aura is consumed in an [gold]Elemental Reaction[/gold].
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_CRYO.title: Applies Cryo
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_CRYO.description: Applies [gold]Cryo[/gold] for [blue]2[/blue] turns. Another aura is consumed in an [gold]Elemental Reaction[/gold].
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_ANEMO.title: Applies Anemo
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_ANEMO.description: Leaves no aura. Another aura [gold]Swirls[/gold]: [blue]2[/blue] unblockable damage to ALL enemies, and the aura spreads.
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_GEO.title: Applies Geo
KLEEMOD-APPLIES_GEO.description: Never stays on an enemy. Another aura is consumed in an [gold]Elemental Reaction[/gold].
KLEEMOD-CONFISCATED.title: Confiscated
KLEEMOD-CONFISCATED.description: A 1-cost Status card that does nothing. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
KLEEMOD-VAPORIZE_PREVIEW.title: Reaction preview: Vaporize
KLEEMOD-VAPORIZE_PREVIEW.description: [gold]Pyro[/gold] meets [gold]Hydro[/gold]: this hit deals 1.5x damage and consumes the aura.
KLEEMOD-MELT_PREVIEW.title: Reaction preview: Melt
KLEEMOD-MELT_PREVIEW.description: [gold]Pyro[/gold] meets [gold]Cryo[/gold]: this hit deals 1.75x damage and consumes the aura.
KLEEMOD-OVERLOAD_PREVIEW.title: Reaction preview: Overloaded
KLEEMOD-OVERLOAD_PREVIEW.description: [gold]Pyro[/gold] meets [gold]Electro[/gold]: deals [blue]6[/blue] damage to ALL enemies and applies [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to the reacted enemy.
KLEEMOD-SUPERCONDUCT_PREVIEW.title: Reaction preview: Superconduct
KLEEMOD-SUPERCONDUCT_PREVIEW.description: [gold]Electro[/gold] meets [gold]Cryo[/gold]: the reacted enemy gains [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], which applies before this hit.
KLEEMOD-ELECTRO_CHARGED_PREVIEW.title: Reaction preview: Electro-Charged
KLEEMOD-FROZEN_PREVIEW.title: Reaction preview: Frozen
KLEEMOD-FROZEN_PREVIEW.description: [gold]Hydro[/gold] meets [gold]Cryo[/gold]: its next action deals 50% less damage. Attacking it ends the freeze and deals [blue]6[/blue] unblockable damage.
KLEEMOD-FROZEN_BOSS_PREVIEW.title: Reaction preview: Vulnerable (Boss)
KLEEMOD-FROZEN_BOSS_PREVIEW.description: [gold]Hydro[/gold] meets [gold]Cryo[/gold]: in a boss fight a non-minion cannot be Frozen; it gains [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] instead.
KLEEMOD-SWIRL_PREVIEW.title: Reaction preview: Swirl
KLEEMOD-SWIRL_PREVIEW.description: [gold]Anemo[/gold] meets an aura: remove it, deal [blue]2[/blue] unblockable damage to ALL enemies, and apply that element to the others.
KLEEMOD-CRYSTALLIZE_PREVIEW.title: Reaction preview: Crystallize
KLEEMOD-CRYSTALLIZE_PREVIEW.description: [gold]Geo[/gold] meets an aura: gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. The aura is removed.
